description:
GitHub Actions workflow rules: triggers, draft guards, path filters, concurrency, permissions, secrets, action pinning, timeouts, caching, artifacts, checkout depth, installs, step naming, actionlint, Dependabot.
Load BEFORE creating or editing any file under `.github/workflows/` or `.github/actions/` (ci.yml, codeql.yml, release-please.yml, reusable workflows, composite actions), including a one-line change.
Trigger on: adding or changing a job, step, trigger, `permissions` block, matrix, or `env`; "add a workflow", "fix CI", "CI is failing", "add a job", "add a step", "pin this action", "add workflow_dispatch", "run it on PRs", "cache the install", "upload the artifact", "why did CI not run", "add dependabot"; scaffolding CI for a new repo; reviewing a diff that touches a workflow file, even when the user never says "Actions".
